title: Uncle Mickey and General Exon at Air Materiel Command
summary: Whitley Strieber tells of Uncle Mickey and General Exon at Air Materiel Command, about 1947 at Air Materiel Command, Wright Field, Ohio, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Air Materiel Command, Wright Field, Ohio

tellings.quote: my uncle Mickey and General Exxon were worked at the air material command in 47.

plain: Whitley Strieber, an author known for writing about his own encounters with strange beings, says his uncle Mickey worked alongside General Arthur Exon at Air Materiel Command, the US Air Force's equipment and research command at Wright Field in Ohio, in 1947. He tells it as a family link to people working there in that year, which he treats as important to the UFO story.
